nom: Clinique Dramatically Different Moisturizing Gel For Face

avis.texte: This product for me is a go to. Always moisturizer no matter the season. I am a sport athlete so this keeps y skin hydrated in the winter and protects it in the sun

avis.titre: It's good on a bare face
avis.texte: This works great on a bare face. It absorbs quickly, and doesn't sit heavy. It doesn't breakyou out or clog you up. But it pills. If you use it with basically anything even clinique's own foundation it forms little balls. It can't be used with sunscreen or even just another moisturizer on top.

I have very dry, acne prone skin. Initially, it felt smooth snd absorbed quickly. The next day, I looked as if I had a chemical or sun burn. This has happened to me with the moisure surge product, as well. I wanted to enjoy these products, but they do not react well with me.
every day go to - great for oily skin and or if you sweat a lot.. amazing for FL
I have a Tzone and this product works amazingly on my skin. It works in and dries without that heavy and greasy feeling other moisturizers leave behind. I would buy this over and over again.

I have tried other moisturizers and haven't found anything that compares to how normal this makes my face feel. I don't use all of this brand for my face regimen and I like that it's versatile with other skin care brands.

avis.titre: I always come back to this!
avis.texte: Anytime I think I can use something else, I realize quickly why I love this moisturizer. The gel aspect absorbs quickly and makes my skin so hydrated and glowy. I can use it morning and night. Always recommend to anyone with oily/combo skin!

I have normal skin type but lean dryer in winter. Recently this spring I started getting a lot of breakouts on my forehead! I went to ulta and bought the face cleanser in mild and this moisturizer. I use a heavier moisturizer on my cheeks but this one on my forehead and I no longer have any breakouts. So relieved to have found this.

avis.titre: I have purchased these items multiple times
avis.texte: I have used clinic moisturizer for over 20 years. Recommended to me by a friend who is a nurse for dry area on my face. It worked and continues to do so. No odor and non- greasy. The Paul Mitchell leave in conditioner leaves my hair feeling light and clean. This I also have used for over 20 years. I recently bought a second bottle for my 14 year old granddaughter who loves the fragrance .
My skin was so dry and I started to use this lotion And it helped me a lot.

Trying to find a new moisturizer to apply before my makeup routine to keep my face hydrated and this was a good change. The gel like feel really makes you feel hydrated and applies nicely to your skin. My skin still dried out hours later so not long lasting.
I have used this moisturizer for a few years now and keep on buying time and time again.
Absolutely love this. I have combination skin and have trouble with most products. This moisturizer is gentle and effective.
I have been using this moisturizer every day for almost two years. It lasts me quite a while.
I was recommended this product from an Ulta employee and i love it! it's inexpensive and it really gets my skin hydrated.
I have used Clinique products my entire life and they are always awesome!!
It's hard to make a comment on something that you ordered a long time ago but never came in.

avis.titre: Been using this for over 35 years
avis.texte: I have used the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion line for a long time, and in the past 4 years, shifted over to the Moisturizing Gel. It absorbs beautifully on my 67-year old face, and I use it daily as a primer for makeup, or even when I am not wearing makeup. I will continue to use this forever!

I've been using this for about 10 years on and off. I always try something cheaper and regret it, then purchase this again. Makeup sits nicely on top of it and doesn't separate, it absorbs quickly rather than just sitting on top of my skin as a lot of moisturizers do. It's very basic, but my skin loves it and it never clogs my pores and I don't look shiny after applying. I still use something more occlusive after harsher treatments, but for everyday use this is a great moisturizer!
Love this lotion it has helped me in many different ways I will continue to purchase this lotion again and again!
I love this moisturizer. It hydrates all while not making my skin feel greasy. Works great even in winter!
I have used Clinique products my entire life and they are always awesome!!
It's hard to make a comment on something that you ordered a long time ago but never came in.

avis.titre: Been using this for over 35 years
avis.texte: I have used the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion line for a long time, and in the past 4 years, shifted over to the Moisturizing Gel. It absorbs beautifully on my 67-year old face, and I use it daily as a primer for makeup, or even when I am not wearing makeup. I will continue to use this forever!

avis.titre: Really nice lotion for oily skin
avis.texte: As someone with oily skin, I was surprised by how well the Clinique "Yellow Lotion" worked for me. The texture looks a bit rich at first, but it absorbs quickly and doesn't leave a greasy film. It gives just the right amount of hydration without clogging pores, and it sits nicely under makeup. It doesn't control oil, so very oily skin might find it a bit too dewy in summer, but as a simple, reliable moisturizer, it's hard to go wrong with this one.
The product is fine … it's the packaging ! The moisturizer I ordered did not came with the original packaging that comes with it … it was just wrapped in papers , not securely packaged!

I've been using this for about 10 years on and off. I always try something cheaper and regret it, then purchase this again. Makeup sits nicely on top of it and doesn't separate, it absorbs quickly rather than just sitting on top of my skin as a lot of moisturizers do. It's very basic, but my skin loves it and it never clogs my pores and I don't look shiny after applying. I still use something more occlusive after harsher treatments, but for everyday use this is a great moisturizer!

This has been my moisturizing gel of choice for the past 10 years (I take it with me on all vacations!). I apply it after each shower. It prevents my face from getting dry, and it never feels greasy. This gel replaces the Dramatically Different Lotion that I previously used; the gel works better on my combination oily skin.

avis.titre: Perfect for my winter skincare needs
avis.texte: I use the moisturizing gel for winters and hydrating jelly for summers. No other moisturizer has done for my skin what the clinique moisturizers have done.
I have been using this for over 35 years!!! It is light and is the perfect moisture product on the market. I have aways had alot of allergies and this product is so pure and amazing!!!
I've used this moisturizer for years. It has no scent, works into the skin so smoothly, and I feel it offers protection and moisture all day.
This hydrating gel offers a clean canvas for whatever comes next. Blurs to a smooth surface making everything you build on top look flawless. A must have.
I cant change it for any other hydration, it is so light and goes perfectly with every skin
Love this lotion it has helped me in many different ways I will continue to purchase this lotion again and again!

avis.titre: I will buy it again and again
avis.texte: The best face moisturizer smooth my face makeup stay all day I loveit
I've been using Clinique since my friend gave it to me in a gift set 20 years ago. I love it and my 17 year old son loves it too!!!! He's never had "teenage skin issues" either. Love it!!!
Have used this product for years; am 59 and I would guess I've been using since I was in early 30's. This product is moisturizing and light and oh so nourishing! Thank you Clinique!!!

This was my birthday gift from Clinique and I'm so pleased! I have skin that is dehydrated but I don't like creams because they usually feel tacky on me. This gel goes on so smoothly and my skin feels moisturized. I use this over the even better serum and I wear city block over top. However, I think it would be good on its own too.

I love the Dramatically Different Moisturizing Gel! I have sensitive, combo skin and this gel is perfect for it. I Love that it's oil-free, too. This has been a big staple in my skincare routine for many, many years!
I have 10 days using this moisturizer and my skin is soooo hydrated!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Clinique Dramatically Different Moisturizing Lotion with SPF 35 and really like how convenient it is. It keeps my skin hydrated without feeling greasy and gives me daily sun protection in one step. The formula feels lightweight and absorbs well, but still gives that classic Clinique moisture. No white cast, no strong scent, and it layers nicely under makeup. It's a solid pick for days when I want to keep my routine simple but still protected.

I have been using this moisturizer for 11 years and I don't think I will ever switch to another one unless for whatever reason they stop manufacturing it. It is so perfect, it does not leave your face greasy but rather it gives you a healthy and soft glow. Highly recommend to the girls with combo skin that are looking to elevate their every day skincare routine

I love how this makes my skin feel. My skin usually gets so oily in the t zone area. My make up use to always melt away. This controlled my oily skin but my skin still felt hydrated at the same time. It's amazing. My makeup stayed put and my skin felt so much healthier, cleaner. My face can finally breathe a sigh of relief. I don't look like greasy mess during the summer anymore.

avis.titre: I would buy this and recommend
avis.texte: Absolutely love the way it makes my skin feel. Yes I will buy it again
Perfect for oily/combo/breakout prone skin. My go-to in the summer months. Light consistency, absorbs nicely, great base for makeup. Little bit goes a long way. Definitely a staple :)

avis.titre: Lightweight and Perfect for Oily Skin!
avis.texte: I've been using this moisturizing gel for a few weeks and absolutely love it! It feels super lightweight on the skin and doesn't leave any greasy residue. It absorbs quickly and gives my face a fresh, balanced look. It's perfect for my oily/combination skin, especially during warmer months. Definitely a staple in my skincare routine!
I have loved this Clinique moisturizer for years and still do. Hope it's never discontinued.

avis.titre: Works exceptionally well for oily skin!
avis.texte: Absolutely love this product — it works exceptionally well for oily skin. From the very first use, I noticed a significant reduction in excess shine, and my face felt fresh and balanced throughout the day.

I've used many different face lotions and I always keep coming back to this one as this is the only one that really makes my face feel hydrated and helps especially in winter with dry skin. I wish it came with a Sunscreen but I still won't stop using it.

I have been using the Clinique Dramatically Different moisturizing gel for 10 years now and I have never switched to another during that yime. This is a great product for me personally: I have normal/dry skin with an oily T-zone. The gel is not sticky at all and the skin abosrbs the product wonderfully! Will forever buy this
After using tons of different moisturizers over many years I feel like I finally found "the one" that's right for me. I've been absolutely thrilled with this since purchasing it.
I bought this and started using it every other day, loved how it controlled my oils then noticed after applying my face felt tight and i had patches of dry spots

Dramatically Different Moisturizing Gel has been my go to moisturizer since I was 13, I'm 47 nearly 48, thats 35 years! I have combo oily and dry skin. This is the only product that balances my oily and dry skin and leaves it balanced, soft and smooth. I use it daily in my 3 step morning and night routine with Moisture surge. I smooth it on my face, neck, decolletage and tops of my hands! Don't be afraid to pump a generous amount to smooth on. It's never left a greasy or a film like feeling. Just smooth healthy glowing skin!
I was so happy years ago when Clinique introduced this formulation. I never could use the lotion-way too greasy for my skin. I have used this since the beginning and can't see myself ever switching.
I have mixed normal to oily skin but this dried me out! only had to use 2x before realizing it wasn't for me. returned

avis.titre: Great as a first step for mature skin
avis.texte: This is a lightweight but effective moisturizer. I use the lotion version daily and got this for my mom to use as a first step/serum replacement for her super sensitive skin. She loves it. It absorbs quickly and she layers a heavier moisturizer on top. Doesn't irritate her skin

avis.titre: passing the classics to my kids
avis.texte: i used this all through high school and now my son uses it and loves it. classic products, reliable!

I like this moisturizer. Makes my face feel nice and smooth. This is definitely for oily skin as it does dry you out a bit. If you have combination skin like me I would recommend using a serum before so your face doesnt get too dry.

avis.titre: My skin did not like this :(
avis.texte: My skin is sensitive and acne prone and it did NOT like this product. It immediately makes my skin red and irritated followed by a burning sensation Also- the cream turns brown when oxidized I guess and there started to be brown crust stuck im the crevices of the cap, yuck. I threw out the half filled bottle
Like your store Very helpful staff at Ulta Store has lots of items that I like

avis.titre: Makes my skin smooth and soft
avis.texte: Clinique's Dramatically Different Moisturizing Gel is truly game-changers! The moisturizing gel provides lightweight, oil-free hydration that absorbs quickly and leaves the skin soft and smooth. Together, this moisturizer is the perfect duo for maintaining healthy, glowing skin. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Best for my acne prone skin
avis.texte: I've used a number of moisturizers at different price points, from Cerave to Tula/Beekman. However, Clinique's moisturizer has given me the most consistent result of being sensitive for my skin and effective at reducing the amount of acne I get. For its price point, I've been happy with its results.

Have tried so many moisturizers over the years but now have found my go to and keeper. This gel feels so nice without feeling oily. I use it at night before bed and in the a.m. to start the day. Have noticed such a difference in my skin since using it.
I have been using this moisturizer for years and I always repurchase, I love how it absorbs into my skin without leaving it oily specially because my skin is so oily.
I love this one more than the lotion. It doesn't feel thick like the lotion. Its great for using under makeup. I always repurchase it!
I've used this as my moisturizer for a few years now. It's my absolute favorite, because it hydrates without irritating or making my skin feel oily.
This is a great moisturizer for all ages. My daughter uses it as well I do. I have dry mature skin.

I tried this moisturizer in an attenpt to replace the Cerave Daily Moisturizer. It absorbed really quickly and I found myself reapplying every 10 minutes to help the peeling. Made my makeup look terrible
This is definitely my favorite moisturizer ever! A little goes a long way, I use this every morning and night. Highly recommend!
My grandmother , mother and now myself and boyfriend all use Clinique religiously. Always leaves us feeling hydrated and have never had a bad reaction to it. The best of the best
I was looking for hydrating moisturizer and it feels amazing when you first put it on but the feeling goes away and it's replaced with a stiff feeling
Works good for me , my skin is very demanding but this moisturizer can take care of it well
I have used this product for 2 years and i can say that every time my skin is fresh and bright! I'm so in love with this product and Clinique!
I love this moisturizer, but hate that you can't use all of it. The pump design is wasteful…always a lot at the bottom that won't pump out.
This face moisturizing gel is perfect for somewhat oily skin. Does not make my face feel greasy or my hair stick to my face.
I absolutely love this product bc it's so light n makes my skin feel so silky soft n moisturized. It's just wonderful. A definite fan n I'll buy it again.

avis.titre: Love the way it makes my skin feel
avis.texte: I love the way it makes my skin feel. My skin feels so soft, not oily not dry. Nice and smooth and clean and fresh.

This is a holy grail product for me. My mom has always used the dramatically different cream but I found it too heavy. The gel is PERFECT for my dry skin!! Ive been using it for about four months and this is the best my skin has ever felt

Even at age 61, I still fight with clogged pores & sensitive skin! However, Clinique has come to the rescue. The DDM Gel is fabulous! I also use the Moisture Surge Lotion essence & Night Mask if I need more moisture. The exfoliating toner 1.0 without alcohol has also made a major difference for me also! Clinique definitely eased & cleared my skin-thanks, Clinique!

avis.titre: Packing doesn't allow full use of product
avis.texte: It really irritates me when packaging for a product does not allow you to use every single drop of the product. I cannot dip my finger to get the bottom layer of product. The straw doesn't reach the bottom!! It's really inconvenient to have to figure out ways to get all the moisturizer out of the bottle. Wasted money if you can't get it all!!

avis.titre: A lighter moisturizer for oily skin
avis.texte: I purchased the smallest size of the DDM gel thinking it might be good in the summer but my skin requires moisturizer at my age. As I've discovered, mature skin needs more protection day and night than the gel provides. I suspect it would be great for a teen but I'm way past that stage.
I apply this twice a day. I love it. I am hooked and will buy this again and again.
My teenage daughters use this and it doesn't break out their acne prone skin

I have struggled to find a moisturizer that is not too heavy/thick but helps with the areas of my face that are dry and the areas that are oily/prone to acne. This moisturizer is the best, so soothing and helps on days that my face is very dry.

I've been using this product for literally 40 years. I did stop for a few years and my skin developed all kinds of problems. This was after I had tried some super outrageously expensive products for 2 years. I went to a dermatologist and she recommended that I go back on the Clinique products. She says that she uses them and recommends them to other patients. I'm so happy with Clinique. It's been so consistently effective on my skin, which is the classification three system. I'll never use anything else again. I bought the Clinique rosacea cleansing system with the foundation to cover up the problems that my skin developed from the expensive products.

ive been using this moisturizer for about a year now, ive had both the lotion and gel and i love both! the gel applies smoothly to the skin and you can feel it go into your skin and it leaves my skin- combination to normal- look like glass with a dewy fresh glow! i personally work it into my skin with an ice roller to leave a cooling effect once the gel dries, i love this gel moisturizer!
I have oily combination skin, this moisturizing gel suits my skin type perfectly

This is my go to have been buying this for about almost two years, however i did notice when buying a new bottle. Im paying the same price for less product!! My old bottle was 6.2 oz and this new one only carrier 4.2 oz. Does not give me option to purchase bigger unless ulta doesnt carry it?? What gives????

Saw this product on discount and thought I would give it a try. I have tried other Clinique products and have always had success. This product did not disappoint. I ran out of my expensive moisturizer and I am glad I did because now I have a new staple. This moisturizer is so soothing and moisturizing. It comes out like lotion, but is not heavy or sticky. Clinique had me again, so many of their products are so good! This item, in my opinion, is great for all skin types .

avis.titre: Game changer in love with this product
avis.texte: I have to say u must get this omg it's amazing iam glad I bought this

I've been using this moisturizer for years. I have normal to dry with an oily T zone, and this moisturizer balances it out. In the past I've tried other moisturizers, but always come back to this one.
This moisturizer is the best!! Once rubbed in, it takes about 30 seconds to dry and it doesn't feel oily or sticky at all. My face feels great!

I have super senstive skin and bad acne. Its usually hard for me to find a good mositurizer that doesnt irritate my skin but this stuff is goldennn! Definetly gonna be my new go-to for mositurizing my face
very good for my dry skin goes on light don't need to apply much goes along way for the money

I live in Chicago, the wind cuts up my face. This moisturizer isn't great for the winter. I have white flaky patches on my face after applying in the morning. I have applied it twice in one morning because it isn't hydrating.

avis.titre: I have used this moist for years
avis.texte: The sales gals are so helpful. I am 1 hr away and always a pleasure to stop in as I also use the Estee Lauder makeiup

I have used this moisturizer at night for my sensitive oily skin for over 30 years. Dependable, gentle and highly effective. I used to use it twice a day but about 10 years ago I started using this at nite along with my skin care routine and Moisture Surge 100h in the am since it enhances my makeup so exquisitely.

avis.titre: I had different expectations for this product
avis.texte: My original reason for buying this gel version was in hopes of a daytime moisturizer that offered more hydration for the winter months but did not leave the heavier feel and slightly greasy appearance of its more heavy duty twin, the regular dramatically different lotion. Sadly, i was very disappointed. This product is not hydrating or protective for my winter skin whatsoever. As soon as i put it on, my skin already feels thirsty and craving more. I'll stick to the 100H moisture surge gel, it hydrates so much better and is the perfect daytime for all seasons.
I am a man who's been using this product for over thirty years and many tell me I do not look my age .
This is for sure my choice for every season. It works on my oily combination skin, in both summer and winter without feeling oily, however, I feel my skin moisturizes very well.

avis.titre: I love this! My go to!
avis.texte: I have oily skin, so the lotion sometimes is too much. BUT THE GEL IS PERFECT! just the right amount of moisture without feeling oily or heavy over my skin.
I can feel the difference on my face and I love it 100%. I don't need much and it keeps my skin moisturized. Though I have oily skin, it doesn't make me feel like I'm adding to it only helping it.
